scope: One-source spiritual successor or exactly-three-source original coherent game synthesis under existing Jeeves game generation owner
default: Original large top-down adventure with authored Zelda/NES adventure, Pokemon/GB fishing and Harvest Moon/SNES farming analog references. No user ROM, original assets or measured original-game behavior is claimed.
composition: Distinct exact source origins, normalized influence weights, actual style preservation strengths, explicit mechanic priorities and confidence-labelled conflict decisions compile original world geometry, shared original sprite atlas, analytic reachable routes, experience graph and coherent adventure/fishing/farming economy.
optimization: Bounded parameter candidates are evaluated through actual same-runtime transitions on fixed selection seeds and separate held-out seeds. Report actual counters, metrics, budgets, before/after and algorithm identity; authored preferences never fabricate reward or success.
authority: Application source owner must authorize every non-original source before generation and workload publication; source withdrawal blocks new compile/optimization admission. Output lineage cannot grant source rights or production promotion.
failure: Wrong source cardinality, duplicate origin, unknown priorities, nonfinite/unbounded mechanics, inconsistent lineage and failed native simulation reject. Portable source emission is not a successful desktop build receipt.
asset_scope: Original deterministic 128x128 RGBA sprite atlas consumed by browser/native/Python renderers; no source sprites, ROM bytes, image crops or music copies.
